title: Ekam
description: Minimalist contemporary residences focused on geometric simplicity and serene natural landscaping.

specifications.structuralSystem: Earthquake-resistant RCC framed structure compliant with IS 456:2000 and IS 1893:2016 Seismic Zone III standards with high-grade Fe550D TMT rebars and M30/M35 design mix concrete.
vastuHighlights: North & North-East main door alignments optimizing ambient morning solar intake
Agni corner (South-East) dedicated kitchen zones with natural cross-ventilation
Water bodies and borewell / underground water tanks placed in North-East (Ishanya) zone
Living-dining hall orientation oriented to capture prevalent South-West summer breezes
amenitiesList: Centrally landscaped green garden with gazebo sit-outs
Children safe play zone with rubberized flooring
Multi-purpose community banquet hall & indoor games arena
Jogging track along the landscaped perimeter green buffer
24/7 CCTV surveillance with boom barriers and access control

floorPlans.title: Typical Floor Core & Circulation Layout
floorPlans.description: Optimized 4-to-6 units per floor layout with central elevator core, dual fire escape staircases, wide 6-foot corridors, and dedicated service shafts ensuring zero cross-visibility between unit entries.

floorPlans.title: 3 BHK Master Residence Plan
floorPlans.description: Generous 18x12 ft living area opening into a 6-foot wide cantilevered deck, separate dining zone, master bedroom with walk-in closet & ensuite bath, secondary bedrooms with external window bays, and utility wash yard.

floorPlans.title: 2 BHK Urban Living Layout
floorPlans.description: Zero dead-space modular configuration maximizing carpet efficiency, open-concept living-dining, modular kitchen with attached utility balcony, and dual cross-ventilated bedrooms.

floorPlans.title: Basement & Stilt Parking Master Plan
floorPlans.description: Two-way 6-metre wide vehicular driveway, demarcated car bays with column protectors, EV charging points, rainwater collection sumps, and mechanical ventilation exhaust shafts.
